meta.title: Other Projects
meta.seoDescription: Beyond the six core projects, TIDE Foundation has run CollegeDev, Prerak, RefugEd, Disha, MOI, and more.

intro: Beyond our six core projects, TIDE Foundation has run and continues to develop additional initiatives responding to specific educational needs in Ahmedabad and beyond.

items.name: CollegeDev
items.desc: Higher education support programme that has engaged 1,056 college-going students across the city.

items.name: Prerak
items.desc: School improvement programme working across 26 schools, 2 remand homes, reaching 14,402 children and 695 teachers.

items.name: RefugEd
items.desc: A past initiative providing educational support to Syrian refugee families resettling in Ahmedabad.

disha.sectionSubtitle: Social-emotional development across schools, orphanages, and communities.
disha.body: Disha has reached 2,082 children across 10 schools, 5 orphanages, 1 village, and 1 slum. The program focuses on life skills, social activism, and community values through experiential activities and celebrations like pre-Diwali events in partnership with local communities.

moi.sectionSubtitle: A platform showcasing innovative solutions — editions in 2017, 2023, and 2024.

prabhav.sectionSubtitle: Research-driven school improvement initiatives in partnership with global education networks.
prabhav.body: Prabhav is TIDE's research initiative studying the impact of holistic education interventions. As part of the global Schools2030 network — a programme by the Aga Khan Foundation — TIDE contributes on-ground data and insights on transformative learning environments.
